shortDescription: Manipulate the PTF database via sqlite3

options.name: action
options.description: The action the C(ibmi_fix_repo_lv1) module takes towards the PTF database. C(refresh), C(list), C(find) or C(clear).

options.name: additional_sql
options.description: The additional sql appended to the query for action 'find'.

options.name: checksum
options.description: Specified if check the image file's integrity when action is 'find' or 'list'

options.name: fields
options.description: The expected output column names of the query result for the 'find' action.

options.name: image_root
options.description: The image_root of the image files.

options.name: parameters
options.description: The query parameters for the 'find' action executed by the task.
